985-3480-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4871-6705-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2921-6097.easyPrerequisites:

You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2921-6097.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1429-2099-6982.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-4661.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-4661.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Doppelganger and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-4661.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1284-6500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible.
1284-6500.description:
Activate Tephraderm by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Tephraderm triggers, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.

1809-5195-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Returned Pastcaller
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Returned Pastcaller
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

513-527-7297.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
513-527-7297.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3259-7208-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7208-7296.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1322-1563-2557-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.

141-2292-3505.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

632-2034-3621-4359-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3621-4359-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

2034-2308-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-6097.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2736-6676.notablePrerequisites: The first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
2736-6676.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Demonic Pact to an opponent.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.

2963-3492-3609-4112.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Sharuum.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

224-654-1772-3861.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Amulet of Vigor and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Orzhov Basilica
Holding priority, activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{B}.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

1479-5478-5700-5701-6528.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5478-5700-5701-6528.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

465-643-1849-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1329-1750-2793-2981-5261.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2633-4867-5487.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Molten Duplication by paying {1}{R}.
Urabrask triggers, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve Molten Duplication, creating a token copy of Cormela.
Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Cormela dies, it triggers, returning Molten Duplication from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

681-1637-4423-4826-5226.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest and two additional lands.
Archelos is untapped.
681-1637-4423-4826-5226.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and two other lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Lithatog's second ability four times by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and two other lands, giving Lithatog +4/+4 until end of turn.
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When each land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary triggers once.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Splendid Reclamation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Repeat.
If you control additional lands, you may sacrifice them as well to get additional mana and triggers.

777-3321-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Filigree Familiar, adding {C}{C}.
When Filigree Familiar dies, its second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Filigree Familiar on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Filigree Familiar trigger, causing you to draw Filigree Familiar.
Cast Filigree Familiar by paying {2}.
When Filigree Familiar enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

2011-2158.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five legendary creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2011-2158.description:
Declare at least five legendary creatures you control as attackers.
If you declared any Warriors as attackers, Najeela triggers for each Warrior, creating that many 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Activate five attacking legendary creatures by tapping them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2744-2760-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Devoted Druid does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2744-2760-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Devoted Druid ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

972-1953-2105.description:
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare one of the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
